notes:
I found two places a family could walk into during August 30 to September 2. Neither page gave me a price I could confirm. I left the Canadian Children's Museum out because I could not confirm it for those days.

```json
{
  "picks": [
    {
      "name": "Canada Science and Technology Museum (ZOOOM - Children's Innovation Zone)",
      "age_fit": "Something for all ages, including ZOOOM - Children's Innovation Zone",
      "when": "Open 9am to 5pm Tuesday to Sunday per Ingenium's page, so Aug 30, Sept 1 and Sept 2",
      "source_name": "Ingenium - Canada Science and Technology Museum"
    },
    {
      "name": "Canadian Museum of Nature, 240 McLeod St",
      "age_fit": "Hands-on activities for curious minds of all ages",
      "source_name": "Canadian Museum of Nature"
    }
  ]
}
```

- **Science and Technology Museum:** Ingenium's own page gives the hours: 
open 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Tuesday to Sunday
. That copy of the page is old. A museum directory verified in July lists summer hours of 
May-Aug Mo-Su 9:00-17:00
, which would also cover Monday Aug 31, but I could not confirm that on Ingenium's page. The "all ages" wording and the ZOOOM zone come from a family-business listing (Chatterblock), not Ingenium's page. The same directory says 
free admission for children and youths aged 17 and under
.
- **Canadian Museum of Nature:** I could not tie the museum's own hours to those four days. A parent-written review gives summer hours of 
9:30 a.m. to 5:00 p.m., Friday to Wednesday
, and says 
from June 19 to September 7, 2026
 kids up to 17 get in free. That review also says 
younger children who learn best through hands-on play will find less to do
, so it may suit a preschooler less well than the Science and Technology Museum.
- **Canadian Children's Museum:** the museum's own page lists hours only for 
Sept. 8 to Dec. 9, 2026
. That is after the visit, so I left it out.
